# `scope_set_guide_rate`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the mount guide rate; the supplied scope implementations always reject it.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | A |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x71ea0 (64-bit build) |

Despite the set_ name the native handler is established as a PURE GETTER: on every supplied scope type the guide-rate capability returns false and the setter stubs only record an error. A disconnected mount gives 315; a connected one gives 210 before the parameters are parsed. The declared numeric parameter is therefore latent and a success reply is not produced by these builds. Clients SHOULD NOT rely on this method. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay. No serial traffic (firmware 9.31, READ).

Side effects: None in the supplied scope types: the capability and setter bodies are error-only stubs.

## Example

Request, request - Example request (values invented):

```json

```

Reply, ok:

